questions.question: When the high priest and his associates became jealous of the apostles, what did they do?

answers.text: Arrested the apostles and put them in jail
Invited the apostles to teach at the temple
Sent the apostles away from Jerusalem

questions.question: After an angel of the Lord freed the apostles from jail at night, what did the angel tell them to do?

answers.text: Go tell the people the full message of new life in the temple courts
Go hide outside the city until the danger passes
Go home and keep quiet about what happened that night

questions.question: When the high priest questioned Peter and the other apostles about their teaching, what did they say they must do?

answers.text: Obey the people rather than rulers
